lines.text: You are doing great. A glass of water would make it better.
Little break? Water is right there.
{{glasses}} {{glassWord}} so far today. That is something.
Your body has been carrying you all day. Give it water.
This is a kind reminder, nothing more.
Water first, then whatever comes next.
You have earned two minutes and a cold glass.
Hope the day is going gently. Have some water.
Still thinking of you. Still hoping you drink something.
{{goalPct}}% of the way there. Every glass counts.
No rush, but your water is waiting.
It is okay to stop for a moment. Really.
Day {{streak}} of looking after yourself. Keep it going.
You have done harder things than standing up.
A glass now saves a headache later.
Whatever you are working on will still be there.
Please drink some water. You matter more than the task.
This is the loud version of caring about you.
Stop for one minute. Water. Then carry on.
You have been going a long time. Please drink something.
I will not be quiet about this one. Have some water.
Water is the easiest kind thing you can do for yourself.
Refill when you pass the tap.
Hydration counts as looking after yourself.
